name: Beidou
title: Uncrowned Lord of the Ocean
description: Captain of her crew, The Crux. She's quite an unbound and forthright woman.

skills.name: Oceanborne
skills.description:
Normal Attack
Performs up to 5 consecutive strikes.

Charged Attack
Drains Stamina over time to perform continuous slashes.
At the end of the sequence, performs a more powerful slash.

Plunging Attack
Plunges from mid-air to strike the ground, damaging opponents along the path and dealing AoE DMG upon impact.

skills.name: Tidecaller
skills.description:
Nothing to worry about. Should anyone raise a hand against her or her men, she will avenge it ten-fold with sword and thunder.

Press
Accumulating the power of lightning, Beidou swings her blade forward fiercely, dealing Electro DMG.

Hold
Lifts her weapon up as a shield. Max DMG absorbed scales off Beidou's Max HP.
Attacks using the energy stored within the greatsword upon release or once this ability's duration expires, dealing Electro DMG. DMG dealt scales with the number of times Beidou is attacked in the skill's duration. The greatest DMG Bonus will be attained once this effect is triggered twice.
The shield possesses the following properties:
·Has 250% Electro DMG Absorption Efficiency.
·Applies the Electro element to Beidou upon activation.
skills.info: Conquer the high seas! Pursue the waves and chase the storm!

skills.name: Stormbreaker
skills.description:
Recalling her slaying of the great beast Haishan, Beidou calls upon that monstrous strength and the lightning to create a Thunderbeast's Targe around herself, dealing Electro DMG to nearby opponents.

Thunderbeast's Targe
·When Normal and Charged Attacks hit, they create a lightning discharge that can jump between opponents, dealing Electro DMG.
·Increases the character's resistance to interruption, and decreases DMG taken.

A maximum of 1 lightning discharge can be triggered per second.
skills.info: With a peal of thunder, Haishan is slain.

passives.name: Retribution
passives.description: Counterattacking with Tidecaller at the precise moment when the character is hit grants the maximum DMG Bonus.

passives.name: Lightning Storm
passives.description:
Gain the following effects for 10s after unleashing Tidecaller with its maximum DMG Bonus:
·DMG dealt by Normal and Charged Attacks is increased by 15%. ATK SPD of Normal and Charged Attacks is increased by 15%.
·Greatly reduced delay before unleashing Charged Attacks.

passives.name: Conqueror of Tides
passives.description:
Decreases swimming Stamina consumption for your own party members by 20%.
Not stackable with Passive Talents that provide the exact same effects.

constellations.name: Sea Beast's Scourge
constellations.description:
When Stormbreaker is used:
Creates a shield that absorbs up to 16% of Beidou's Max HP for 15s.
This shield absorbs Electro DMG 250% more effectively.

constellations.name: Upon the Turbulent Sea, the Thunder Arises
constellations.description: Stormbreaker's arc lightning can jump to 2 additional targets.

constellations.name: Summoner of Storm
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Tidecaller by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Stunning Revenge
constellations.description: Upon being attacked, Beidou's Normal Attacks gain an additional instance of 20% Electro DMG for 10s.

constellations.name: Crimson Tidewalker
constellations.description:
Increases the Level of Stormbreaker by 3.
Maximum upgrade level is 15.

constellations.name: Bane of Evil
constellations.description: During the duration of Stormbreaker, the Electro RES of surrounding opponents is decreased by 15%.

outfits.name: Rolling Waves
outfits.description: Beidou's outfit. Lightweight clothing saturated with a brave seafarer's spirit.

voices.title: Hello
voices.text: I'm Beidou. You've heard of my ship, The Crux and its crew? If you too love adventure, then join me. I've got your back.

voices.title: Chat: Sparring
voices.text: If you ever want to trade tactics, I'm always ready.

voices.title: Chat: Drinking
voices.text: Ah! A cold beer after a hard day's work... Nothing like it!

voices.title: Chat: Land
voices.text: It's hard to remain on dry land for so long. Can never seem to quite get my land legs back.

voices.title: When It Rains
voices.text: When stuck on a deserted island, rain is a precious source of drinking water. There's no need for it now though.

voices.title: When Thunder Strikes
voices.text: Hey, it's just a little lightning. No need to fear it on the open ocean, so there's even less need to fear it on dry land.

voices.title: When It's Windy
voices.text: This weather would be great for setting sail.

voices.title: When the Wind Is Blowing
voices.text: Wind's picking up. If sand gets in your eyes, be sure not to rub them.

voices.title: Good Morning
voices.text: Yo, good morning. I'm about to head off, coming with me?

voices.title: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Let's get Xiangling to whip us up something for lunch. Believe me, a hot meal from her is far better than the salted fish we eat out at sea.

voices.title: Good Evening
voices.text: Alright, I'm off for a drink. Hahaha, no one willing to sell you a proper drink, huh? Perhaps I can...

voices.title: Good Night
voices.text: Time moves quickly. Haha, go, may the wind be at your back.

voices.title: About Beidou
voices.text: We're setting sail! Men, to your posts! A new adventure is about to begin!

voices.title: About Us: Titles
voices.text: I'm the captain, so you can be my first mate! Deal? Ha? Such names are too outdated for you huh? We'll call each other whatever you wish then.

voices.title: About Us: Eye for People
voices.text: I tend to be a good judge of character. When you've learned to read the open ocean, reading people is a cinch. Haha, and that's how I knew you're the good sort the second I laid eyes on ya!

voices.title: About Us: Choices
voices.text: I chose you as my crewmate, as my comrade on the sea. It gives me great pride to be able to say that.

voices.title: About the Vision
voices.text: To those that don't have a Vision, it must seem that those with Visions are like flagships from the Archons to follow. As such, I make sure to fly my flag with pride. That is my motivation.

voices.title: Something to Share
voices.text: At a loss? When you don't know what to do, just take the first step. The rest will figure itself out naturally.

voices.title: Interesting Things
voices.text: Every time I return from a long journey and I see the lapis gledes, I'm reminded that I'm almost home. The scenery out on the open ocean gets familiar real quick. Sure, they're birds of prey, but seeing them fly so freely is heart-warming.

voices.title: About Ningguang: Liyue Qixing
voices.text: Ningguang, eh? As far as Liyue Qixing is concerned, she seems to be doing a good job. But for me, my responsibility lies with my ship and my men, and not with Liyue Qixing.

voices.title: About Ningguang: Attitudes
voices.text: Ningguang is never really one to speak frankly, but she has been very direct with her criticism of me in the past. Haha... But hey, whether she likes me or hates me is her choice, nothing I can do to sway her.

voices.title: About Xiangling: Culinary Skills
voices.text: When we're out on the open ocean, the one thing we do all miss is Xiangling's cooking. When spirits are low, just thinking of her fried jueyun chili, bursting with flavor... It gives everyone just that little extra kick.

voices.title: About Xiangling: Food Tasting
voices.text: Xiangling huh? She sometimes uses some... interesting ingredients in her dishes to bring about some, ah... intriguing flavors. Though... there's no way she can improve without having someone to taste-test — a role that I am more than happy to fill.

voices.title: About Zhongli
voices.text: You mean the gentleman from Wangsheng Funeral Parlor? My men sometimes speak of the rumors surrounding him — he sounds interesting. Yes, if I get the chance I'd like to meet him someday.

voices.title: About Xiao
voices.text: One year on the eve of the Lantern Rite, we ran into a storm as we were returning to port. Try as we did, we only made it back to Liyue Harbor in the dead of night, long after the lanterns had all been released. As I looked towards Guyun Stone Forest, I saw an adeptus, floating in the air, in the form of what appeared to be a young boy. I guess it is like the legends say — there really must be those that watch over Liyue, even if they cannot be seen.

voices.title: About Ganyu
voices.text: Privately, Ganyu and I get on like a house on fire! But as you know, she's the secretary to the Liyue Qixing... and I'm not exactly in their good books right now! Doesn't bother me, but I wouldn't want to put Ganyu in a difficult position. So just keep what I said between us, yeah?

voices.title: About Xinyan
voices.text: She's got a great personality, that one! The guys in the crew love that rock and roll of hers. Me? We have common ground, just... not when it comes to taste in music.

voices.title: About Yaoyao
voices.text: Yaoyao always comes on board to play when we're in the harbor. Trouble is, when it's time for her to go she gives you the puppy eyes, and no one has the heart to send her away... Means we're always cutting it quite close by the time we manage to set sail.

voices.title: About Kaedehara Kazuha
voices.text: Kazuha? That scallywag actually blocked a strike from the Raiden Shogun outside Tenshukaku! Easier said than done... After the battle he came to the Crux Fleet — said he'd voyage with us a while longer. I was more than happy to oblige. If the day comes when he decides to set off again by himself on the next stage of his journey, I'll send him off with a drink, haha...

voices.title: More About Beidou: I
voices.text: Before you step foot on The Alcor, you need to answer one question. When the sea is full of perils — why is it that you still wish to come aboard my ship?

voices.title: More About Beidou: II
voices.text: You want to know of my legendary tales? Hahaha, that's just my men exaggerating, adding in their own little details. Although, if you were to ask me if I'm afraid of what monsters lurk in the deep, I'd tell you I have no fear of them.

voices.title: More About Beidou: III
voices.text: You wanna know why I help the common folk? Why not? Everyone has their low points in life. I don't really do anything, other than help steer those who are truly lost towards a brighter future.

voices.title: More About Beidou: IV
voices.text: I've been through some hard times. When I was a child we had little money, so nothing to eat, and lived for years by stealing fruit off of people's trees. Even after I got my own ship, I was cast out by pompous merchants. But me telling you such stories is merely for your amusement. I have no intention of making you live through it too.

voices.title: More About Beidou: V
voices.text: I have many brothers that sail with me. I have asked, and remember, why each and every one of them came on board. You, however, are special. I know you still have your own things to deal with, and as such, I won't try to rope you into coming onboard permanently. But remember, there is always a place for you onboard The Alcor.

voices.title: Beidou's Hobbies
voices.text: My hobbies...? Eh, lemme think... Well, there's adventure, sailing, making friends, drinking, eating... more than I can count on one hand.

voices.title: Beidou's Troubles
voices.text: If you can change something, change it. If you can't, don't waste time thinking about it. That's how I go about things. But really, if you get stuck, come find me. I'll help you deal with it.

voices.title: Favorite Food
voices.text: I like food with robust flavors. Spicy fried meat or spicy tofu are my favorites. Sitting down to a big hearty meal together, where everyone can fill their bellies — now that's when things get lively! Haha, alright, alright, all this talk is making me hungry!

voices.title: Least Favorite Food
voices.text: I'm not a fan of anything cold, it does nothing to fire up my appetite. I'd rather fry up a few fish.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: I
voices.text: Tastes good, I like it! Mind giving me a bowl of rice with this?

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: II
voices.text: Your cooking skills aren't bad at all, eating your food has me in a good mood.

voices.title: Receiving a Gift: III
voices.text: You know, at the end of the day, food is food, and that's fine by me.

voices.title: Birthday
voices.text: Come, board my ship. I've gathered the crew. The food and drink are all prepared. Today is your birthday, so you are the captain. Haha, so: where should we set sail?

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Intro
voices.text: Great! I feel much stronger.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Building Up
voices.text: We're making progress. Let's crack open a bottle to celebrate!

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Climax
voices.text: A prime example! It is an honor to have you aboard. I need to keep up if I'm to keep the respect of my crew.

voices.title: Feelings About Ascension: Conclusion
voices.text: After all this training, I feel like I'm finally at my best. Thank you... But please, I'd still like for you to keep me on my toes.

voices.title: Elemental Skill: I
voices.text: Back off!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: II
voices.text: Ha!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: III
voices.text: Back at ya!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: IV
voices.text: Take this!

voices.title: Elemental Skill: V
voices.text: Hurrrh!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: I
voices.text: Power that ended Haishan!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: II
voices.text: Eyes on me!

voices.title: Elemental Burst: III
voices.text: To ashes!

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: I
voices.text: Huh, where've you been hiding?

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: II
voices.text: Nice, I'm starting to lose count!

voices.title: Opening Treasure Chest: III
voices.text: The Mora the merrier. First round's on me!

voices.title: Low HP: I
voices.text: It's not over!

voices.title: Low HP: II
voices.text: Hah, I've still got some kick.

voices.title: Low HP: III
voices.text: I never yield.

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: I
voices.text: Get behind me!

voices.title: Ally at Low HP: II
voices.text: Get back! Don't be a hero.

voices.title: Fallen: I
voices.text: This isn't good...

voices.title: Fallen: II
voices.text: Men... Fall... back...

voices.title: Fallen: III
voices.text: Crew... Set sail for home...

voices.title: Light Hit Taken: I
voices.text: Just a scratch.

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: I
voices.text: You haven't won yet.

voices.title: Heavy Hit Taken: II
voices.text: Not bad.

voices.title: Joining Party: I
voices.text: Alright, let's go!

voices.title: Joining Party: II
voices.text: Come with me.

voices.title: Joining Party: III
voices.text: I trust you.
